---
name: research-release
description: Prepare a reproducible research release from validated V-series evidence.
---

Before release:
1. Verify the central research-integrity gate.
2. Verify source and generated artifact hashes.
3. Check version and citation metadata.
4. Confirm README claims match machine-readable evidence.
5. Ensure unresolved scientific questions are explicitly marked.
6. Prefer deterministic artifacts and immutable references.
7. Never publish a stronger claim than the tests support.
